body.zh-Hant: 1875年3月4日生於布達佩斯。1901年起為自由黨黨員，1905年成為獨立黨的議員，1913年出任獨立黨主席。大戰最後一年，他明確展開和平鼓吹。
body.en: Born in Budapest on 4 March 1875. A member of the Liberal Party from 1901, he became an Independence Party deputy in 1905 and its president in 1913. In the last year of the war he campaigned firmly for peace.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年10月31日國王卡爾四世任命他為總理，1919年1月11日他成為共和國總統。1919年3月21日他辭職，同年7月初以親協約國政治人物身分流亡西方。
body.en: King Charles IV appointed him prime minister on 31 October 1918, and on 11 January 1919 he became president of the republic. He resigned on 21 March 1919 and emigrated to the West in early July 1919.

body.zh-Hant: 1847年10月2日生於波森。1859至1866年就讀軍校（卡德特學校）。第一次大戰爆發時他已在漢諾威退休，原本沒有安排任用。
body.en: Born at Posen on 2 October 1847. From 1859 to 1866 he attended the cadet schools. When the war broke out he was living retired in Hanover and no employment was foreseen for him.

citations.quote: 1859-66 die Kadettenanstalten in Wahlstatt

heading.en: Command in the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 1914年他出任第八集團軍司令，同年11月1日統轄東線全部德軍；1916年8月29日接替法金漢，出任總參謀長。戰後他請辭離任。
body.en: He became commander of the 8th Army in 1914 and on 1 November 1914 took the supreme command over all German troops of the Eastern Front. On 29 August 1916 he succeeded Falkenhayn, then Chief of the General Staff. After the war he took his leave.

body.zh-Hant: 1925年4月，他本人無黨籍，以跨黨派候選人身分參加帝國總統選舉的第二輪。1933年1月30日他依憲法任命希特勒為總理。他於1934年8月2日去世，帝國總統一職隨之消滅。
body.en: In April 1925, himself without party, he stood as a non-partisan candidate in the second round of the Reich presidential election. On 30 January 1933 he appointed Hitler Reich Chancellor in accordance with the constitution. He died on 2 August 1934, and the office of Reich President lapsed with his death.

body.zh-Hant: 1880年3月2日生，1948年4月20日歿。畢業於盛岡中學、海軍兵學校與海軍大學校。曾任橫須賀鎮守府司令長官等職，1936年任聯合艦隊司令長官。
body.en: Born on 2 March 1880 and died on 20 April 1948. He graduated from Morioka Middle School, the Naval Academy and the Naval War College. He served as commander-in-chief of the Yokosuka Naval District and other posts, and in 1936 became commander-in-chief of the Combined Fleet.

body.zh-Hant: 次年（1937年）他在林內閣出任海相，其後在第一次近衛內閣與平沼內閣留任。1940年1月組閣出任首相，同年7月內閣總辭。東條下台後，他在小磯內閣復任海相，並歷任鈴木、東久邇、幣原各內閣的海相。
body.en: The following year (1937) he became navy minister in the Hayashi cabinet and stayed on in the first Konoe and Hiranuma cabinets. He formed a cabinet in January 1940 as prime minister, and it resigned en bloc in July of that year. After Tojo stepped down he returned as navy minister in the Koiso cabinet and served in the Suzuki, Higashikuni and Shidehara cabinets.

people.nameZh: 庇護十二世（歐金尼奧·帕切利）

body.zh-Hant: 尤金尼奧·帕切利1876年3月2日生於羅馬，1899年4月2日晉鐸。1911年他接任貝尼尼的職務，出任教會特別事務部的副秘書。
body.en: Eugenio Pacelli was born in Rome on 2 March 1876 and ordained priest on 2 April 1899. In 1911 he succeeded Monsignor Benigni as undersecretary of the Congregation.

citations.quote: Eugenio Pacelli nacque a Roma il 2 marzo 1876
Ordinato sacerdote il 2 aprile 1899

body.zh-Hant: 1917年5月，本篤十五世任命他為駐慕尼黑教廷大使。1920年8月教廷與已成共和國的德意志帝國建立直接外交關係，帕切利並獲託管新設的柏林使館。1929年12月16日的樞機團會議上他被授予樞機。
body.en: In May 1917 Benedict XV appointed him papal nuncio at Munich. In August 1920 the Holy See and the now republican Reich government established direct relations, and Pacelli was also entrusted with the new Nunciature of Berlin. He received the cardinal's hat in the consistory of 16 December 1929.

citations.quote: nel maggio 1917 fu nominato da Benedetto XV
nunzio pontificio a Monaco di Baviera

body.zh-Hant: 1930年2月9日他意外被召喚接替加斯帕里。庇護十一世去世後，樞機帕切利在經三輪投票的短暫秘密會議後，於1939年3月2日當選接任，取名庇護十二世。
body.en: On 9 February 1930 he was unexpectedly called to succeed Gasparri. After the death of Pius XI, Cardinal Pacelli was chosen to succeed him in a very brief conclave ending at the third ballot on 2 March 1939, and took the name Pius XII.

citations.quote: il 9 febbraio 1930 fu inaspettatamente chiamato a succedere a Gasparri

heading.en: Origins and the Committee of Union and Progress

body.zh-Hant: 1864年2月19日生於開羅。1908年9月3日被排除出國務院編制，同年12月14日蘇丹任命他為元老院議員。1912年他當選統一與進步委員會總書記。
body.en: Born in Cairo on 19 February 1864. On 3 September 1908 he was dropped from the Council of State staff, and on 14 December 1908 he was appointed to the Senate (Âyan). In 1912 he was elected general secretary of the Committee of Union and Progress.

Aynı yıl İttihat ve Terakkî Cemiyeti’nin genel sekreterliğine seçildi

body.zh-Hant: 1913年1月25日他入內閣任國務院長，三天後獲任外交大臣。1913年6月前任遇害後，他翌日出任大宰相，並兼外交大臣，於1913年6月17日組成政府。1915年10月15日辭去外交大臣；1917年2月3日以健康不適為由離開大宰相之位。
body.en: He entered the cabinet as president of the Council of State on 25 January 1913 and three days later was appointed foreign minister. In June 1913, the day after his predecessor was killed, he became grand vizier, also took the foreign ministry, and formed his government on 17 June 1913. He resigned as foreign minister on 15 October 1915 and left the grand vizierate on 3 February 1917, citing indisposition.
